decisions.reason: Transactional email builds directly on the firm's core expertise in enterprise messaging infrastructure and was featured on the home page, so the firm can readily interpret its results and improve it.
Managed capture extends the firm's established document and fax processing knowledge and has a documented customer reference, giving it a clear base for learning and further development.
Email-fax conversion sits squarely within the firm's long-standing fax and email messaging competence, so it fits its existing knowledge base and is cheap to maintain.
As a feature of the firm's core fax service it draws on deep existing know-how, though it may be absorbed into the main fax offering rather than kept as a separate item.
Sandboxing complements the firm's email security portfolio, and its related knowledge in threat filtering supports ongoing improvement, unlike the dropped multi-engine scanner.
